verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic retries for transient errors, error surfacing with stack traces, and AI-assisted debugging, which supports part of the reliability story, but there is no explicit evidence of an execution log/history viewer or a manual 're-run from the failing step' feature. missing for 10: documentation of execution history/log inspection UI, explicit 'resume from failing step' re-run capability, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
